import json
from pathlib import Path

from urllib.parse import urlencode
from urllib.request import urlopen

from makemarket.provenance import receipt

record = {'provenance': receipt({'purpose':'check newest text and multimodal Qwen releases using task-filtered official catalogues'}),
          'source': Path(__file__).read_text(), 'responses': {}}
for task in ('text-generation', 'image-text-to-text'):
    params = {'author':'Qwen','pipeline_tag':task,'sort':'createdAt','direction':-1,'limit':100,'full':'true'}
    url = 'https://huggingface.co/api/models?' + urlencode(params)
    with urlopen(url, timeout=60) as response:
        status, rows = response.status, json.load(response)
    assert all(r.get('pipeline_tag') == task for r in rows)
    models = [{k:r.get(k) for k in ('id','sha','createdAt','lastModified','pipeline_tag','tags','cardData')}
              for r in rows]
    record['responses'][task] = {'url':url,'status':status,'models':models,
                                  'limit':100,'interpretation':'Newest creations within this task, not all model families or a capability ranking.'}
    print(task, json.dumps([{k:m[k] for k in ('id','createdAt')} for m in models[:8]]))
record['interpretation'] = 'Cross-check the previous newest-general-purpose family decision. Later specialist releases or repackagings are not evidence that a newer general-purpose family fits the available GPUs.'
Path('results/training/qwen_task_catalogues_20261030.json').write_text(json.dumps(record,indent=2)+'\n')
